scope: Mandatory requested-capability native execution envelope; raw proof is required after acquisition, not a static source-value assertion
pre_native_status: pending actual native acquisition; no P claimed
failure_rule: Missing, mismatched, invented or incoherent required native proof is U/error and blocks the requested pool/evidence/reuse gate regardless of an accepted component-profile summary.

gates.applies_to: Every actual fresh native acquisition, including compatible pooled-device reuse; not a no-SDK package-review/finalization transition
gates.predicate: A genuinely new App/test capture session is launched with exact current input and fresh starting event interval. Device identity may persist; old process/input/callback/image evidence cannot masquerade as new capture. A PID alone is insufficient.
gates.provider: Original native XCTest count/name/result, actual App PID/lifetime and launch-instance/session receipt, exact fixture/action/input records and exported original attachments. Compare successive fresh acquisitions using these real identities.

gates.predicate: Every used native frame/target/event interval belongs to its exact approved state, current fixture index/hash, coherent process/session and original event revision. Torn or mixed packets cannot pass.
gates.provider: Documented original runtime/state_captures/observation_set/dispatch bindings plus the default execution/coverage reconstruction; preserve raw identity paths and values.

gates.predicate: A real successful caller update advances native input index 0 to 1 within the same capture app/session, changes marker/detail to the fixed replacement values, keeps visible count one, and has exact empty callback delta. No restart pair substitutes.
gates.provider: caller-update-quiet, marker/detail/count native assertions, successful caller-update dispatch and actual before/after native process/session/input/event receipts.

gates.predicate: Unique enabled actual native primary and last controls are dispatched using the documented real platform route; exact original callback intervals are [probe.primary] and [probe.last]. Unexecuted/blocked delivery stays U.
gates.provider: Original successful dispatch/target/method receipts and event assertions. iOS uses XCUI activation; Android is layoutlib Compose semantic action, with no physical-touch claim.

gates.predicate: Source/build/bridge/input/action/environment identity is current; required full states have complete native overlapping top/bottom/content/sentinel evidence and all mandatory rows. An eligible reused original keeps its exact bytes, provenance and current validation; force-fresh means real new native acquisition.
gates.provider: Original verified capture/execution/coverage/build/native-environment receipts and independently retained package/file hashes; exact per-platform dependency maps.

gates.predicate: Owned native resources respect the admitted cap/lease/expiry policy and are retired at required lifecycle closure; borrowed resources are preserved. Retirement costs and leftovers remain visible.
gates.provider: Actual resource journal/lease, raw create/reuse/retire replies, independent before/after inventory, durable closure receipt and enclosing timing trace.

gates.predicate: The fresh layoutlib capture uses the exact new native test/composition/input/event session and caller replacement remains attached within it. No claim is made about an Android OS App process, physical device or physical touch.
gates.provider: Actual JUnit/Gradle/native capture session, attached ComposeView state/input/event binding and original images/hierarchy for the admitted Paparazzi module.

gate_conjunction: User-requested qualification requires these mandatory native gates, mandatory atomic/source/environment/coverage/resource gates, exact same A/B P/F/U and no increased mandatory U, plus at least 20% collection reduction. An SDK result or component-profile accepted flag alone is insufficient.
unsupported_extra: mounted-component-instance remains an independently retained advisory U and cannot be converted to P by the above gates.
